newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fina says wins 20 blocks in Mexican Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Fina says wins 20 blocks in Mexican Gulf.

text.p: Fina Inc, a U.S. unit of Belgian oil group Petrofina, said in a statement that along with its partners it had successfully bid for 20 blocks in the Gulf of Mexico.
The 20 blocks were among 39 it had bid for in the central OCS Lease Sale number 166 conducted on March 5 in New Orleans.

It said the total amount of the 20 successful bids, including partners portions, was $19.5 million. The 20 blocks cover 10 prospects with water depths ranging 538 to 8,438 feet - with an average depth of 5,553 feet.

"These blocks will add appreciably to the quality and quantity of the company's Gulf exploration inventory. The sale also reflects Fina's continued commitment to this most promising of world-wide geographical provinces," the statement said.
The statement said Fina preferred participating with partners so that it would have between 25 and 50 percent working interest in the prospects.
During mid-March a Fina-operated rig would be moved onto one of its prospects in the Gulf, the Ewing Banks 953, in 700 feet of water.
Fina said the new blocks should ensure its continued exploration success well into the next century.
